requirement:
When authoring evidence for a requirement, its complete fenced declaration MUST
be included in the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`.
rationale: Pending implementation and verification of this authoring source-input behavior. Documentation references do not demonstrate implementation.

text: A requirement has an implementation citation in one function, a test citation in
another, and a terminology reference. The initial prompt contains the complete
requirement, both functions, and the required definition as evidence inputs.
